name: Motion Canvas
description: Programmatic animation with a TypeScript generator API and live editor.
why: Good for technical explainers and deterministic motion.

name: Manim
description: Python animation engine for mathematical and technical explainers.
why: A strong choice for precise diagrams and equation-driven motion.

name: FFmpeg
description: The standard command-line toolkit for audio and video processing.
why: Almost every video pipeline eventually needs it for encode, trim, and mux.

name: p5.js
description: Creative coding library for canvas sketches and generative art.
why: A low-friction way to make algorithmic visuals for the web.

name: HyperFrames Skills
description: Video skills for launch films, explainers, music videos, charts, maps, captions, and rendering.
why: A complete agent-first video workflow with a registry of editable blocks.

name: Remotion Skills
description: Skills for creating, animating, captioning, and rendering Remotion videos.
why: Useful when the project already uses Remotion.

name: DaVinci Resolve editing and post-production training
description: Blackmagic Design publishes editor, colorist and Fairlight training with downloadable project exercises for DaVinci Resolve.
why: Follow the native timeline editing, grading or mixing exercises for the relevant application version.

name: After Effects expression basics
description: Adobe explains how to add expressions to animation properties, link values and inspect the result in After Effects.
why: Apply the expression to an editable property and scrub the composition to verify motion. Requires After Effects.

name: Premiere text-based editing
description: Adobe documents transcript-based rough cuts, source media transcription and edits to a Premiere sequence.
why: Use transcript selections to build an editable interview sequence. Requires Premiere.

name: Remotion caption data and rendering
description: Remotion documents timed caption data, subtitle utilities and displaying captions in a composition.
why: Check caption timing and line grouping in the Remotion composition. Check the Remotion license for the intended use.
